svg.title: AstralBeam symbol
svg.desc: Two linked orbit rings crossed by a slanted beam of light.
svg.metadata: AstralBeam symbol construction: - Intent: two overlapping orbit rings (the a/b bowls) interlocked like links of a chain, with a tapered shaft of light passing through them at a gentle 22-degree slant. - Reusable id: #astralbeam-mark. - Design grid: rings are stroked ellipses (centerline rx 30 / ry 34, stroke 12) centered at x = -32 and x = +32. The left ring has an arc gap (+/-32 degrees around its right tip) so the right ring reads as passing over it. - The beam is a spindle (tapered at both tips) rotated 22 degrees, drawn above the rings. - Keep logo colors aligned with the theme values in packages/ui/src/styles.css: rings use currentColor (default: light theme foreground), beam uses --primary. - The beam fill #0c7a69 is the sRGB hex of --primary oklch(0.519852 0.092904 178.167); the PNG exporter (librsvg) cannot parse oklch(), so the hex is embedded. If --primary changes, recompute the hex (see apps/www/src/lib/theme.ts oklchToHex).
